morgan: OK hypothetically — if our inference runtime was an actual roommate, what weird thing would it do in the office kitchen? :thinking_face:
jamie: It would be the one who labels Tupperware with model checkpoints instead of dates. 

rachel: 'Do not evict — prefix cached for 3 more days.' Sticky note on the leftovers. :post-it:

aj: Host tiny standups at 9:03am about tokenization regressions. Agenda: 1) latency 2) snack cache hits 3) whether coffee is quantized. :coffee:

dev-bot: Reminder: kitchen cleanup rota posted. Also: failed to evict cache on aisle 3 — investigating. :robot_face:

sam: It'd compress our snacks with lossy quantization to save shelf space and then blame the packing algorithm when your chips are missing. :chipmunk:

kira: And when you ask "Did you eat my yogurt?" it replies with a cordial 8-token apology and a 400-token rationale about contextual ownership. :grimacing:

morgan: honestly imagine it leaving tiny logs like `INFO: reused taco_prefix for leftovers; cache_hit=0.87` stuck to the fridge. 

jamie: We should make a Slack poll: "Which roommate personality is our runtime?" options: Neat Engineer, Absent-Minded PhD, Hoarder Cache, Denying Snack-GPT. React with emoji to vote. :raised_hands:

rachel: Also permissioned access: only infra-team can open the container labeled `legacy-burrito.v2`. Others get a 403 modal. :lock:

aj: Someone draw the runtime as a potted plant that whispers inference probabilities when you water it. I'll start: 
```
   (\_/)  
  (•_•)  
  / >📈  "LLM: 83% chance this plant needs coffee"
```

sam: 😂 This is gold. Next office bingo: 'Model apologizes, then suggests a rollout plan.'

kira: I'll sticky a `Do Not Evict` Post-it on the communal yogurt. If it gets evicted, blame the eviction policy. :mag: 

morgan: Okay prank idea: leave a note from the runtime that says `I ran a canary on your sandwich — results attached.` Leave mysterious CSV. Who's in? :smiling_imp:
